testResults.name: yaml-syntax-and-version
testResults.command: uv run --isolated --no-project --python 3.12 --with PyYAML python -c <YAML syntax and schema-version assertions>
testResults.result: uv installed PyYAML into an isolated Python 3.12 environment and parsed all 3 files as schema_version 1 mappings

testResults.name: documented-knob-coverage
testResults.command: uv run --isolated --no-project --python 3.12 --with PyYAML python -c <market-lake configuration assertions>
testResults.result: Assertions passed for AAPL/SPY SIP raw trades and quotes with separate history valves; daily nearest-two OPRA expirations and spot-relative strike window; SPY/QQQ/AAPL rolling two-year option soak and disabled expansion toward ten; BTC/USD and ETH/USD trades and quotes with disabled approximately twenty-pair rollout and explicit shared-quota priority; XNYS holidays and half-days plus continuous UTC days; and documented provider, storage, backfill, queue, API, SAS, SQL, lifecycle, budget, logging, and reporting controls

testResults.name: credential-value-scan
testResults.command: uv run --isolated --no-project --python 3.12 --with PyYAML python -c <parsed YAML credential-value scan>
testResults.result: A recursive key-aware YAML scan found no non-empty credential-bearing keys; raw text scans found no AWS access IDs, private-key headers, URL userinfo, signed-query parameters, or bearer-token values

testResults.result: Exit code 1: none of the versioned YAML files are ignored

testResults.name: diff-quality
testResults.command: git diff --no-index --check -- NUL <scoped-file> (for each of the 4 untracked T015 files)
testResults.result: Each file returned the expected no-index difference exit code with no whitespace diagnostics; an ASCII decode and trailing-whitespace scan also passed

assumptions: T015 is market-lake configuration; quant-harness configuration remains owned by its later roadmap tasks
The task export fixes behavior and selected values but leaves several numeric bounds open, so clearly commented conservative defaults are supplied for T026 to validate
The two initial crypto pairs are examples for validation; rollout remains disabled until T060 approves the approximately twenty-pair universe
limitations: No application loader was run because typed YAML and environment override loading belongs to T026
PyYAML was installed only in a uv-isolated verification environment; no project dependency was added
